source_evidence: src/net_class.cpp and src/netdaemon.cpp now use the real SDK timeGetTime import for the18 owned consumers. Removed NetTimeGetTimeSlot and obsolete typedefs. Preserved existing direct versus cached source calls, timestamp writes and timeout conditions; no hardcoded original clock-slot operand remains in live product code.

recovery/tests/test_network_clock_import.py verifies the pinned original IAT identity and both compiler trials, including wrong-API, old-slot and mixed-valid/invalid-call controls. The complete focused sound/clock/popup run passed155 tests, all357 selected protected claims across12 TUs reproduced, and a fresh configured application build/link passed. These are bounded checks, not network protocol or whole-image acceptance.

Independent review identified preexisting clock-capture differences in Net6320E0 and NetDaemon5303B0/530AA0. net-clock-capture-restoration-20260920 stays pending; this resolution covers the import-identity repair only, not full body matching or callback/read-timing equivalence.
